description: Playbook for landing one evidence-approved single-skill intake whose L4 topology is a NEW fusion generic plus one named implementation: create the generic and its prerequisites, create the named skill, ingest each verified evidence row, and appraise Trust Magnitude — then stop at the calibration gate. Use when: an intake issue carries intake:topology-approved and intake:evidence-approved, the promotion PR review/meta/intake-<N> is open, and a reviewed evidence manifest exists. Triggers: "ingest the approved intake", "land intake #N", "add the generic and named skill for this intake", "run the ingest for the evidence-approved batch". Not for suites (use gaia-fuse-full-suite), not for an existing generic (add the named skill with `gaia dev add --named` directly), and not for star calibration (dev-calibrate).
